paragraphs: Ryan Tayman was the lone former Mustang to appear in a confirmed professional game on Friday, batted 3rd and started at C for St. Lucie Mets against Daytona Tortugas. St. Lucie Mets beat Daytona Tortugas, 2-0.
Away from the box scores, there was also roster movement involving former Mustangs.
Steven Brooks was called up on Friday, moving from the High-A Greenville Drive to the Double-A Portland Sea Dogs.
title: Ryan Tayman scores as St. Lucie Mets picks up a win
